import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_77/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, list them here
    ]

    # List to hold transformed DataFrames
    transformed_dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source data
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Select relevant columns: fac_type and capacity
        # Capacity might have missing or non-finite values, so clean them
        df_sub = df[['fac_type', 'capacity']].copy()

        # Convert capacity to numeric, coerce errors to NaN
        df_sub['capacity'] = pd.to_numeric(df_sub['capacity'], errors='coerce')

        # Drop rows where capacity is NaN or infinite
        df_sub = df_sub[df_sub['capacity'].notna()]
        df_sub = df_sub[df_sub['capacity'] != float('inf')]
        df_sub = df_sub[df_sub['capacity'] != float('-inf')]

        # Group by fac_type and sum capacity
        df_grouped = df_sub.groupby('fac_type', as_index=False)['capacity'].sum()

        # Convert capacity to integer (safe now because no NaNs or infs)
        df_grouped['capacity'] = df_grouped['capacity'].astype(int)

        transformed_dfs.append(df_grouped)

    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    combined_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group again by fac_type to aggregate across all sources
    final_df = combined_df.groupby('fac_type', as_index=False)['capacity'].sum()

    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_77/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    final_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
